name: tr_battle
caption:
IF JAMISON BATTLE WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🏹 Decidueye, the archer: 89 threes as a George Washington freshman, a school record
🐟 Magikarp, the overlooked: undrafted in 2024, we signed him anyway
💦 Blastoise, the cannons: 24 points at New Orleans, 6-of-8 from three
🐲 Bagon, the dreamer: from a two-way deal to a standard 3-year contract
❄️ Froslass, ice cold: 14 points, all in the 4th quarter, no misses, in our playoff win over Cleveland
🐉 Gyarados, the ace: 42.1% from three through 9 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Freshman at George Washington: program single-season record 89 three-pointers; undrafted in the 2024 NBA draft, signed by Toronto July 16, 2024, converted to a two-way contract; November 27: career-high 24 points, 6-of-8 three-pointers, road win at New Orleans; February 7, 2025: converted into a standard three-year (3-year) contract; April 23, 2026, Game 3 of the first round vs Cleveland: 14 points, all in the fourth (4th) quarter, perfect shooting, 126-104 win
